name: ipackage
description: 多机 CLI 包版本监控与一键更新面板

scripts.build: npm -w server run build && npm -w web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w server run typecheck && npm -w web run typecheck
scripts.app:build: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run dist
scripts.app:start: npm -w web run build && npm --prefix desktop run dev
scripts.app:share: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run dist:share
